cases.name: Delores Raye Jones Griffin
cases.narrative: Her daughter came home from school and found her missing. Her body was  found in a lagoon at Sterling State Park in Monroe County, Illinois shortly after she disappeared, but went unidentified for over forty years. She had stab wounds to the heart and was severely beaten with fractures to her cheek and jaw. She was buried under the name Jane Doe. Griffin's body was identified in 2019
